description:
Remove the lease check from the git hooks. Leases are enforced when a mutation is written, so the hook is a second check of the same rule at the wrong moment (`@/charter/D-18`, `@/charter/D-20`).

## Background

Testing `aeafc378` with the real pre-commit hook in a strict repository showed the check refuses another session's leased record and also the lead's own closed issue after its lease is released, so a lead's sync commit fails routinely there. The same test found the hook reads an omitted `enforce_leases` key as `off` while `jit config` reports `strict`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `scripts/hooks/pre-commit` and `scripts/hooks/pre-push` no longer check issue leases. Lease enforcement stays at mutation time, with its existing tests. `jq` and agent-identity handling go with it where nothing else needs them.
- [hard] REQ-02: A strict repository's sync commit passes the real hook, with other sessions' records and the lead's own closed issue in it.
- [hard] REQ-03: Whatever remains of the hook, such as the global-config divergence check, gets the enforcement mode from `jit`, so the hook and `jit config` cannot disagree, and an omitted key means the same in both. If nothing remaining needs the mode, drop it.
- [hard] REQ-04: Docs for `enforce_leases`, `scripts/hooks/README.md`, the hooks command and error text state the new scope, including the limit that a hand edit of a record is no longer caught at commit. Net lines are reported and negative.

## Notes

- If the hook enforces something mutation-time checks do not cover, beyond hand edits, stop and report it to the epic's invoker.
- 627fdcc4 is to be rejected once this lands, since it rewrites a check that no longer exists, unless its other criteria still apply to something.
title: Remove the lease check from the git hooks
